class.name: LocalLoopbackSession
class.brief_description: An in-process session that links [LocalMultiplayerPeer] instances and simulates the link between them.
class.description:
Session time advances only when something advances it, which is what makes a delay countable in polls instead of in wall clock and a run reproducible. [codeblock] var session := LocalLoopbackSession.new() var server := session.get_server_peer() var client := session.create_client_peer() session.poll()
session.set_link_conditions(server, LocalLinkConditions.wifi()) [/codeblock] Conditions are installed on the RECEIVING peer, optionally narrowed to one sender, and they apply at receive time: [codeblock] put_packet ┖╴the receiving peer offers the packet to its session ┠╴no conditions the packet queues immediately ┖╴conditions the packet waits in flight until it is due and a poll releases it [/codeblock] Peer ids are drawn rather than counted, so nothing may hardcode one. Read it back with [method MultiplayerPeer.get_unique_id].

method.name: advance_time
method.description: Advances session time by [param ms] and delivers whatever came due, for steppers that drive time themselves rather than off physics frames.

method.name: clear_all_link_conditions
method.description: Removes every installed condition and flushes every delayed packet.

method.name: clear_link_conditions
method.description: Removes the conditions installed for [param sender_id] and flushes whatever they were holding.

method.name: create_client_peer
method.description: Creates a client peer, links it to the server in both directions, and returns it.

method.name: get_client_peer
method.description: Creates a client peer and returns it.

method.name: get_client_peers
method.description: Returns every client peer this session handed out, including ones that have since closed.

method.name: get_link_conditions
method.description: Returns the conditions installed on [param peer] for [param sender_id], or [code]null[/code] if there are none.

method.name: get_server_peer
method.description: Returns the server peer, creating it first if necessary.

method.name: get_shared_session
method.description: Returns the process-wide session, creating one on first access. Use [method has_shared_session] to ask whether one exists without creating it.

method.name: has_live_server
method.description: Returns whether this session's server peer exists and is not disconnected.

method.name: has_shared_session
method.description: Returns whether a process-wide session exists.

method.name: hold_inbound_packets
method.description: Holds every packet bound for [param peer], including ones already queued, until [method release_inbound_packets].

method.name: in_flight_count
method.description: Returns how many packets are still in flight to [param peer].

method.name: init_server_side
method.description: Creates the server peer if there is not already a live one.

method.name: is_holding_inbound
method.description: Returns whether [param peer] is holding everything, per [method hold_inbound_packets].

method.name: poll
method.description: Advances session time by one physics period and delivers whatever came due.

method.name: poll_frame_scoped
method.description: Advances session time by however many physics frames have actually passed. A latency in milliseconds therefore stays that latency however many idle frames the engine ran between physics steps.

method.name: purge_packets_from
method.description: Drops whatever [param sender_id] still has in flight, on every receiver.

method.name: release_inbound_packets
method.description: Delivers what [method hold_inbound_packets] held, ahead of anything that arrived after it.

method.name: reset
method.description: Closes every peer and empties the session so a new server can host.

method.name: set_link_conditions
method.description: Installs [param conditions] on packets arriving at [param peer]. A [param sender_id] of [code]0[/code] conditions every sender. Packets already queued on [param peer] are pulled back into flight, so conditioning a live link leaves no hole behind it. [param conditions] is cloned, so editing it afterwards changes nothing.

method.name: set_shared_session
method.description: Installs [param session] as the process-wide one, or clears it when [param session] is [code]null[/code].

members.member: An application tag carried alongside the session, so a client can tell whose server it reached.
